name: God's Eye View v0.3 Live Satellite and World Tracker
description: Track real satellites, flights and world events on a live 3D globe.

upstream.license: MIT (source code only; bundled and live data keep their own terms)

PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on; the public domain and Railway's healthcheck use it.

GEV_APP_UPSTREAM.description: Private host:port of the gods-eye-view service.

GEV_UI_USERNAME.description: Login name for the globe (HTTP basic auth). Letters, digits and . _ @ - only.

GEV_UI_PASSWORD.description: Login password, generated at deploy (at least 12 characters). Change it here and redeploy the gateway.

GEV_PUBLIC_ACCESS.description: true removes the login. Visitors then see your Google Maps and Cesium ion keys; the app refuses its paid routes (voice, Places, TomTom, Mapillary).

PORT.description: Port vite preview listens on (upstream default); the gateway and Railway's healthcheck use it.

GEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated host names the app answers (upstream Host allowlist). Add your custom domain here.

CESIUM_ION_TOKEN.description: Optional, free for eligible personal non-commercial use: Google Photorealistic 3D and world terrain via Cesium ion. Browser-visible; built into the bundle.

GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY.description: Optional, metered: direct Google Photorealistic 3D, place search and Street View. Browser-visible; restrict it to your domain. Built into the bundle.

GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_API_KEY.description: Optional, metered: separate server-only Google key for Places, Geocoding and the camera Street View fallback. Falls back to GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY.

MAPILLARY_CLIENT_TOKEN.description: Optional, free: Mapillary street-level photos. A public client token by design; built into the bundle.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional, metered: voice control (OpenAI Realtime) and the AI HUD summary. Server-side only.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional, metered: Gemini Live as an alternative voice provider. Server-side only.

AISSTREAM_API_KEY.description: Optional, free: live ships from aisstream.io. Server-side only.

FIRMS_MAP_KEY.description: Optional, free: NASA FIRMS active-fire detections (map key). Server-side only.

TOMTOM_API_KEY.description: Optional, free tier: TomTom live flow speeds for the traffic layer. Server-side only.

OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional, free account: OpenSky OAuth client id for more flight-polling credits. Anonymous access works without it.

OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional: OpenSky OAuth client secret, paired with OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID.

LL2_API_TOKEN.description: Optional, paid: Launch Library 2 token for higher limits. Public access (15 calls/hour, cached) works without it.

ONTARIO_511_API_KEY.description: Optional, free developer key: adds the Ontario 511 traffic cameras.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional: a GitHub token with no extra scopes for the GhostMaps layer's GitHub API calls (shared cloud IPs hit the anonymous limit).

OVERPASS_UPSTREAMS.description: Optional: comma-separated Overpass API URLs you run or pay for. Upstream uses no public Overpass instance by default.

GEV_RATELIMIT_OPENAI_PER_MIN.description: OpenAI token and HUD-summary requests per minute. Behind the gateway all users share one budget. 0 = unlimited.

GEV_RATELIMIT_GOOGLE_PER_MIN.description: Google Places requests per minute (upstream's advice for non-localhost hosts). Shared by all users. 0 = unlimited.

TOMTOM_DAILY_TILE_BUDGET.description: Max TomTom tile fetches per UTC day (upstream default, about 186k a month). Counter kept on the volume.

GEV_REBUILD_ON_KEY_CHANGE.description: Rebuild the browser bundle at start if the three browser keys differ from the image's build (needs about 2 GB RAM).
